Paste only the complete draft generated by `python support.py report` (optionally
with `--probe-model`). Review it before submitting. Do not add email, screenshots,
attachments, account details, paths, transcripts, raw logs or credentials.

Submission shares the report with everyone who can access this repository.
An AI must obtain the user's explicit approval of the full draft and destination
before submitting. This template cannot technically prevent unsafe submissions.
